Expert Technical Support Engineer
description:
Technical Support Engineer
   

  

 Position Summary
   

  

 We are seeking a skilled Technical Support Engineer to act as the critical link between Level 2 Support and Development teams. The role involves investigating, diagnosing, and resolving complex technical escalations across enterprise healthcare applications and secure messaging solutions.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in Windows Server environments, SQL Server, HL7 interfaces, and application troubleshooting. This role requires excellent analytical skills, root cause analysis capabilities, and experience managing escalations through to resolution while maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Infrastructure \& Database Support
   

  

* Troubleshoot issues within Windows Server environments.
* Utilize PowerShell for connectivity validation, service management, process monitoring, and system diagnostics.
* Manage certificates, security configurations, and Event Viewer analysis.
* Interpret and troubleshoot SQL Server and ODBC\-related errors.
* Monitor, execute, and support SQL Agent jobs.
* Perform SQL\-based troubleshooting and data integrity validations.


 Application \& Integration Support
   

  

* Trace and troubleshoot HL7 message flows and interface\-related issues.
* Investigate message queue backlogs and integration failures.
* Support secure messaging solutions and endpoint connectivity.
* Troubleshoot IIS, ASP.NET, and application\-layer issues.
* Review application configurations and identify root causes across the technology stack.


 Escalation Management
   

  

* Reproduce issues in test and production environments.
* Analyze and classify defects based on severity, frequency, and software versions.
* Gather diagnostic evidence including application logs, SQL traces, network traces, and user recordings.
* Document findings, workarounds, root cause hypotheses, and reproduction steps.
* Coordinate escalations between Support, Engineering, and Development teams.
* Manage incidents through ITSM platforms and track PRBs and defect tickets.


 Documentation \& Client Communication
   

  

* Communicate technical findings effectively to customers and stakeholders.
* Create and maintain Knowledge Base (KB) articles.
* Provide detailed troubleshooting documentation and escalation summaries.


**Required Skills**
 Operating Systems \& Infrastructure
   

  

* Windows Server
* PowerShell
* Windows Services
* Event Viewer
* Certificate Management
* Citrix and Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI)


 Web \& Application Technologies
   

  

* IIS
* ASP.NET / .NET Framework
* Application Configuration Management
* Stack Trace Analysis
* Authentication and Security Tokens


 Database Technologies
   

  

* Microsoft SQL Server
* SQL Agent Jobs
* ODBC
* SQL Extended Events
* SQL Troubleshooting and Query Development


 Integration Technologies
   

  

* HL7
* Enterprise Interface Engines
* Secure Messaging Solutions
* Identity \& Access Management Systems
* EHR Integrations


 Networking
   

  

* TCP/IP
* DNS
* Firewalls
* Network Ports
* PKI and Certificate Management


 Tools \& Platforms
   

  

* Azure DevOps
* GitHub
* ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms
* Log Analysis and Diagnostic Tools
* AI\-enabled troubleshooting and automation tools


**Preferred Skills**
* Browser Developer Tools
* Fiddler
* Wireshark
* Linux
* Docker
* Container Technologies
* Microsoft Azure
* Amazon Web Services (AWS)


**Preferred Domain Experience**
 Experience within Healthcare IT environments is highly desirable, including knowledge of:
   

  

* HL7 Workflows
* ADT (Admission, Discharge, Transfer)
* Patient Matching
* EHR Systems
* EDMS/DMR Platforms
* Clinical Workflows and Healthcare Integrations


 Key Competencies
   

  

* Advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis
* Environment isolation and issue reproduction
* Escalation and incident management
* Defect classification and release mapping
* Strong customer communication skills
* Technical documentation and knowledge management
* Cross\-functional collaboration and stakeholder management

Application Architect-AI Integration
description:
**Introduction**
 A career in IBM Consulting is built on long\-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long\-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
   

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 As an Application Architect for AI Integration, this role is responsible for designing and governing end\-to\-end architectures that embed AI capabilities into enterprise applications and workflows. The Application Architect collaborates with stakeholders to translate business objectives into scalable designs, balancing vendor\-managed services with custom development, and drives governance for AI integration.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**
* Designing Architectures: defining reference patterns for AI services, models, and orchestration layers to integrate seamlessly with existing systems, APIs, and data platforms.
* Collaborating with Stakeholders: translating business objectives into scalable, resilient, and policy\-compliant designs, ensuring performance, security, compliance, and cost objectives are met.
* Governing AI Integration: driving governance for prompts, guardrails, and lifecycle management, ensuring observability, privacy, and responsible AI principles are embedded from design through operations.


**Preferred Education**
 Master's Degree
   

  

**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
* AI Architecture Design: Experience with designing end\-to\-end architectures that embed AI capabilities into enterprise applications and workflows, ensuring seamless integration with existing systems, APIs, and data platforms.
* Technical Governance: Experience with driving governance for prompts, guardrails, and lifecycle management, ensuring observability, privacy, and responsible AI principles are embedded from design through operations.
* Reference Pattern Development: Experience with defining reference patterns for AI services, models, and orchestration layers, including Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) and hybrid reasoning.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Experience with collaborating with stakeholders to translate business objectives into scalable, resilient, and policy\-compliant designs, balancing vendor\-managed services with custom development.
* AI Service Integration: Experience with integrating AI services, models, and orchestration layers with existing systems, APIs, and data platforms, meeting performance, security, compliance, and cost objectives.


**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
* Advanced AI Concepts: Experience with emerging AI technologies and trends, such as explainable AI and edge AI, can be beneficial.
* Cloud Native Services: Knowledge of cloud\-native services and serverless architectures can be advantageous in designing scalable AI integrations.
* Data Platform Integration: Familiarity with integrating AI services with various data platforms and APIs can be useful.

* Solution Development: Exposure to developing tailored solutions that meet clients' unique business needs and industry requirements, leveraging industry expertise and knowledge of products and solutions.

* Advanced Solution Development: Experience implementing complex solutions that meet clients' unique business needs and industry requirements, leveraging industry expertise and knowledge of products and solutions.
